what: One body with two product pages on one port. Both pages carry the DefinedTerm 'Occupied housing unit' with termCode HU-OCC in inDefinedTermSet http://HOSTPORT/glossary.json.

overlaid.second.html: passes_all/index.html with the second product's name in <title>, <h1> and the Dataset name; the DefinedTerm is byte-identical
overlaid.data.json: passes_all/data.json plus a second record, identifier http://HOSTPORT/second.html, carrying every field the first carries

why: B5 is judged per body over the body's product surfaces. Every other fixture is one product on its own port, so no control could hand B5 two surfaces of one body.
variant: body_two_products_split overlays only its own second.html (termCode OCC-2) over this directory
